description: Hallo everyone, we are first year students of Software Engineering in UTM Johor Bahru. We are very excited to join this kind of event, we do not only want to compete with all of you, we also want to learn, identify, and be better day by day!
summary: CADET-1 is a browser game that trains junior astronauts in two modes. In Outpost Ops, students command a four-person base on the Moon or Mars for 30 days. Each day they split the crew's work between maintenance, construction, farming, ice mining, science and rest, and spend build points on solar arrays, a fission reactor, batteries, life support, greenhouses and regolith shielding. Live forecasts show how many days oxygen, water, food and power will last, so every choice has a visible cost. Day and night at each site come from NASA JPL Horizons data, so a Moon base must survive a real 14-day lunar night. Solar flares, dust storms and breakdowns force trade-offs, and a debrief links each mistake to a real mission fact. In Flight Academy, students fly a spacecraft through three stages and pass short quizzes. Together they make mission trade-offs tangible and fun instead of oversimplified or overwhelming.
details:
WHAT IT DOES

CADET-1 has two modes. Outpost Ops is a turn-based base manager: the player runs a Moon or Mars outpost for 30 days and must keep four astronauts alive, under a radiation limit, and productive. Flight Academy is a 3D flight simulation with three stages (gyro stabilization, energy collection, satellite alignment), each followed by a three-question quiz.

HOW IT WORKS

Every day the player assigns crew work blocks and builds modules. A forecast panel shows the result before they commit: power made and wanted, and how many days each supply will last. Power goes to life support first, so a shortage slows science and construction before it endangers the crew. Shielding lowers the indoor radiation dose, but outdoor work is unshielded. During a solar flare the player chooses between sheltering and losing the day's outdoor work.

NASA DATA

Sunlight for every mission day comes from the NASA JPL Horizons System: the Sun's elevation at Mare Tranquillitatis and Jezero Crater. This gives the Moon mission 11 days of sun followed by a 14-day night, and gives Mars about 23% of a lunar day's sunlight. The Mars radiation rate is from NASA's Curiosity RAD measurements.

BENEFITS AND IMPACT

Students experience real engineering trade-offs instead of reading about them. The end-of-mission debrief connects what went wrong to how real missions handle it.

TOOLS

TypeScript, React, Three.js (WebGL 2), Tailwind CSS, Vite and Bun, with 72 automated tests and GitHub Actions CI. It runs in a browser with no install.

CREATIVITY AND FACTORS CONSIDERED

We used an 8-bit arcade style to hold young learners' attention, kept the reading level simple, softened failure (crew are evacuated, not lost), and separated real data from game-design numbers in our README.

AI USE

AI coding assistants helped write parts of the code, tests and documentation. Details are in the README section "AI (SI) tool use".
